column1: # Walltime limits for the batched jll443 sweep (profile jll443: 1 warmup + 4 measured
# calls per batch job): conservative per-case estimates of the run time,
#   walltime = 1.5 x (overhead + 5 x t/call) + 30 min margin, rounded up to 30 min, >= 1 h,
# where overhead is process start, compilation and JIT. The 1.5 covers node-to-node
# spread (up to ~20%). For cases expected to run out of memory, t/call was extrapolated:
# reactant_mincut_off N=128 1120 s and N=256 3270 s, enzyme_naive N=256 400 s.
# Lines: config<TAB>N<TAB>HH:MM:SS (submit.sh --walltimes reads lines with 3 tab fields).
